_about: AUTHORED by the game team. Settings for the recorded narration (web/scripts/narration.ts). 'provider' picks the service: 'elevenlabs' (default; the team's paid account) or 'azure' (Microsoft Azure Speech, free tier). ElevenLabs: Greek and English use eleven_multilingual_v2 (best quality, 1 credit per character); Italian, Spanish and German use eleven_flash_v2_5 (half a credit), so all five fit about 90,000 credits. Find voices with `npm run narration -- --library --lang el` (free previews), add one with --add, and put its voice_id under elevenlabs.voices. 'say_as' changes how a word is pronounced in the recording only (the screen keeps the original), e.g. the project name ARGUS. After changing the provider, a model, a voice or the settings, run with `--redo`. Needs review: the voices (listen first) and the pronunciation of ARGUS in Greek.
